text_block_list.name: Narration
text_block_list.text:
Makoto and {0} continue their
patrolling duties while clearing up a number of issues along the way.
text_block_list.orig_text:
浜辺の困りごとを解決しながら、
マコトと{0}は海の見回りを続けていた。

text_block_list.name: Makoto
text_block_list.text:
Phew.
Seems like things've finally calmed down on the beach.
text_block_list.orig_text:
ふぅ。
浜辺の方は
ようやく落ち着いてきたな。

text_block_list.name: Makoto
text_block_list.text:
We barely had a chance to take a breather.
I figured we'd be busy, but not [i]this[/i] busy.
text_block_list.orig_text:
息つく暇もなかったな。
忙しいのは分かってたけどよ、
ここまでとは思わなかったぜ。

text_block_list.name: Makoto
text_block_list.text:
Then again, it's good that we haven't had to deal
with any near drownings or injured people.
text_block_list.orig_text:
まぁでも、
今んとこ溺れた人とか、
怪我人が出てないのはいいことだよな。

text_block_list.name: Makoto
text_block_list.text:
Accidents at the beach can come at the cost of someone's life.
The less work we have to do, the better.
text_block_list.orig_text:
海の事故は
命に関わるからなぁ。
あたしらの出番なんて
ない方がいいに決まってる。

text_block_list.name: Makoto
text_block_list.text:
Which reminds me.
How well can you swim?
text_block_list.orig_text:
それはそうと、
{0}って
どれくらい泳げるんだ？

text_block_list.name: Makoto
text_block_list.text:
I remember you coming close to drowning
when we all went to the beach together.
text_block_list.orig_text:
そういや
前に姫さんたちと海に行ったとき、
おまえ、溺れかけてたよな。

text_block_list.name: Makoto
text_block_list.text:
I see, I see.
So not too well, then?
text_block_list.orig_text:
ふんふん
なるほど、
あんまり泳げないって？

text_block_list.name: Makoto
text_block_list.text: Mind showing me a more concrete example?
text_block_list.orig_text:
どの程度なのか、
ちょっと泳いで見せろよ。

text_block_list.name: Makoto
text_block_list.text:
Ahhh... Okay.
Now I get it.
text_block_list.orig_text:
あ～、
うん。
なるほどなぁ。

text_block_list.name: Makoto
text_block_list.text: Not exactly the best display from a fellow beachside officer, if I'm being honest.
text_block_list.orig_text:
海のお巡りさんを名乗るには、
ちょっと心許ないかもな。

text_block_list.name: Makoto
text_block_list.text:
Oh? Sounding super confident there.
You'll go get it? Get what, exactly?
text_block_list.orig_text:
おう、
なんだその自信。
取ってくる？　
何をだ……？

text_block_list.name: Makoto
text_block_list.text:
A special plan? And what would that be?
Hey, where're you running off to?
text_block_list.orig_text:
秘策？
　なんだよ、秘策って？
おい、
走ってどこ行くんだ？

text_block_list.name: Makoto
text_block_list.text:
Ahh...
I was curious why you sounded so confident, but really now...
text_block_list.orig_text:
あー……
やたら自信ありそうだから
何かと思ったら。

text_block_list.name: Makoto
text_block_list.text: You're gonna bust a swim ring out just like that?!
text_block_list.orig_text: 浮き輪かよ！

text_block_list.name: Makoto
text_block_list.text:
And you look super proud about it, too!
Hm? You won't drown as long as you have that?
text_block_list.orig_text:
しかもすげぇ得意げだな？
ん？
　これがあれば溺れない？

text_block_list.name: Makoto
text_block_list.text: Well, as long as you're cool with it...
text_block_list.orig_text:
{0}がいいなら、
それでいいんだけどよ……

text_block_list.name: Makoto
text_block_list.text:
Plus,  I'll spring into action first if anything goes down.
You ain't gotta push yourself.
text_block_list.orig_text:
でもまぁ、
どうせ何かあったときは
まずあたしが助けに行くしな。
おまえは無理するんじゃねぇぞ。

text_block_list.name: Makoto
text_block_list.text: Collateral damage can be one of the scariest parts about accidents at the beach.
text_block_list.orig_text:
海での事故は
二次災害ってやつが怖いからな。

text_block_list.name: Makoto
text_block_list.text:
Oh, sorry. In this case, that refers to when
someone ends up drowning while trying to save another person.
Hoist by their own petard and all that.
text_block_list.orig_text:
ああ、
えーと
二次災害ってのは、
溺れたやつを助けようとしたやつが
また溺れる、
みたいな。
ミイラ取りがミイラになるってやつだよ。

text_block_list.name: Makoto
text_block_list.text:
Huh? What does that mean? Uh...
Argh! This whole exchange is an example of it!
Well, not quite, but still!
text_block_list.orig_text:
え？
　ミイラ取りがミイラにってのは、
その……
まさに今このやり取りが二次災害だよ！
いや、
ちょっと違うけど！

text_block_list.name: Makoto
text_block_list.text: Anyway—
text_block_list.orig_text: とにかく──

text_block_list.name: Man
text_block_list.text: Help! A child's drowning!
text_block_list.orig_text:
子供だ！
　子供が溺れてるぞ！

text_block_list.name: Makoto
text_block_list.orig_text: っ！

text_block_list.name: Makoto
text_block_list.text: Let's hurry!
text_block_list.orig_text: 急ぐぞ！

text_block_list.name: Makoto
text_block_list.text: Where's the kid that's drowning?!
text_block_list.orig_text:
おい、
溺れてるやつはどこだ！

text_block_list.name: Man
text_block_list.text: Over there!
text_block_list.orig_text: あそこだよ！

text_block_list.name: Makoto
text_block_list.text:
How'd he get that far out?!
Did the current drag him away?!
text_block_list.orig_text:
子供だけであんな遠くに！？
海流に流されちまったのか！

text_block_list.name: Makoto
text_block_list.text: Just wait! I'll be right there!
text_block_list.orig_text:
待ってろ、
すぐ行く！

text_block_list.name: Makoto
text_block_list.text:
You wait here, {0}!
Got it?!
text_block_list.orig_text:
{0}はここで待ってろ、
いいな！

text_block_list.name: Makoto
text_block_list.text: Raaaghhh!
text_block_list.orig_text: うおおぉ──！

text_block_list.name: Makoto
text_block_list.text: I made it!
text_block_list.orig_text:
よし、
間に合った！

text_block_list.name: Boy
text_block_list.text: *gasp* Ahhh!
text_block_list.orig_text:
わっぷ、
あぅっ！

text_block_list.name: Makoto
text_block_list.text:
I'm here to help!
Calm down and grab on to me.
text_block_list.orig_text:
助けに来たぜ！
落ち着いて、
あたしに掴まりな。

text_block_list.name: Boy
text_block_list.text: *pant, pant*
text_block_list.orig_text:
はぁ、
はぁ……！

text_block_list.name: Makoto
text_block_list.text: That's it. Just keep still and hold on tight.
text_block_list.orig_text:
そのまま暴れず、
しっかり掴まってろよ。

text_block_list.name: Makoto
text_block_list.text:
All right, we're back on the shore. You're safe now.
Take some deep breaths. You're not hurt anywhere, are you?
text_block_list.orig_text:
よし、
浜辺に着いたぞ。
もう大丈夫だ。
落ち着いて深呼吸しろ。
どこも痛いとこはねぇな？

text_block_list.name: Boy
text_block_list.text: ...with me.
text_block_list.orig_text: ……ちゃんが。

text_block_list.name: Makoto
text_block_list.text: Huh? Something wrong?
text_block_list.orig_text:
え？
　どうした？

text_block_list.name: Boy
text_block_list.text:
My sister... was with me too...!
Please... Please save her!
text_block_list.orig_text:
お姉ちゃんが……
一緒にいたの……！
お願い……
お姉ちゃんを
助けて！

text_block_list.name: Makoto
text_block_list.text:
She's even further out!
Dammit!
text_block_list.orig_text:
もっと沖の方に……！
クソッ！

text_block_list.name: Makoto
text_block_list.text: I'll be right there!
text_block_list.orig_text: 待ってろよ……！

text_block_list.name: Makoto
text_block_list.text:
Just a bit more... Tch.
Swimming this much is taking its toll!
text_block_list.orig_text:
もう少し……
ちっ、
連続して泳ぐのは
やっぱキツイな……！

text_block_list.name: Girl
text_block_list.orig_text: っ！

text_block_list.name: Makoto
text_block_list.text: You okay?!
text_block_list.orig_text:
大丈夫、
か……！？

text_block_list.name: Makoto
text_block_list.text:
Uh-oh. She's not looking great.
I gotta drag her back myself!
text_block_list.orig_text:
まずいな、
こっちは限界そうだ……！
なんとか背負って、泳ぐしか……！

text_block_list.name: Makoto
text_block_list.text:
Crap... I'm about at my limit!
I gotta get her back to shore, at the very least!
text_block_list.orig_text:
やべぇ……
こっちも体力の限界だ……！
でもなんとか、
この子だけは……！

text_block_list.name: Makoto
text_block_list.text:
Ugh! I swallowed some of the water!
Dammit! I'm passing out...!
text_block_list.orig_text:
やべっ、
水飲んじまった……！
くそっ、
意識が……！

text_block_list.name: Makoto
text_block_list.text: I shouldn't have... brought up the idea of... collateral damage...
text_block_list.orig_text:
ミイラ取りがミイラに、
なんて話、
するんじゃなかったな……

text_block_list.name: Makoto
text_block_list.text:
...?
What's that? A swim ring?
text_block_list.orig_text:
？
　なんだ、あれ、
浮き輪──？

text_block_list.name: Makoto
text_block_list.text: *cough, cough*
text_block_list.orig_text: げほっ、がほっ！

text_block_list.name: Makoto
text_block_list.text:
Oh... It's {0}.
What're you looking so worried for?
text_block_list.orig_text:
あー……
{0}か。
そんな心配そうな顔して、
どうした？

text_block_list.name: Makoto
text_block_list.text:
Ah. Now I remember.
I lost consciousness while trying to save that kid, didn't I?
text_block_list.orig_text:
……って、
そうか。
あたし……
救助中に、意識を失って……？

text_block_list.name: Makoto
text_block_list.text: Wait. What happened to the kid?!
text_block_list.orig_text: 子供はどうなった！？

text_block_list.name: Makoto
text_block_list.text:
They took her to the medical room,
but she's gonna make it? That's a relief.
text_block_list.orig_text:
そうか……
今は救護室か。
命に別状がないのなら、
よかった。

text_block_list.name: Makoto
text_block_list.text: How come I'm okay...?
text_block_list.orig_text:
あたしは
どうして……？

text_block_list.name: Makoto
text_block_list.text: Did you save me?
text_block_list.orig_text:
もしかして、
{0}が助けてくれたのか？

text_block_list.name: Makoto
text_block_list.text:
Actually, I remember what happened now.
You swam as hard as you could using that swim ring.
text_block_list.orig_text:
いや、
覚えてるぜ。
あの浮き輪で、
必死に泳いでくる
おまえの顔。

text_block_list.name: Makoto
text_block_list.text:
Thanks for saving me.
And sorry for being so pathetic.
choice_data_list: You were cool as can be.
text_block_list.orig_text:
助けてくれて、
ありがとよ。
それと……
情けねぇところ
見せちまったな。

text_block_list.name: Makoto
text_block_list.text:
Hehe...
You're full of it...
text_block_list.orig_text:
……へへ。
ほんと、
おまえって……

text_block_list.name: Makoto
text_block_list.text:
That reminds me.
I swallowed a fair amount of sea water, right?
text_block_list.orig_text:
……そういえば、
あたし
結構水飲んでたよな？

text_block_list.name: Makoto
text_block_list.text:
Did you perform first-aid on me, too?
Haha. Now I'm glad I taught you.
text_block_list.orig_text:
救急処置とかも、
{0}がやってくれたのか？
ははっ、
教えといてよかったな。

text_block_list.name: Makoto
text_block_list.text: Hm?
text_block_list.orig_text: ん？

text_block_list.name: Makoto
text_block_list.text: Wait a minute.
text_block_list.orig_text: ……ってことは。

text_block_list.name: Makoto
text_block_list.text: Hey, did you...?!
text_block_list.orig_text:
まさか、
おまえあれっ！

text_block_list.name: Makoto
text_block_list.text: Did you do it...?!
text_block_list.orig_text:
しっ、
したのか……！？

text_block_list.name: Makoto
text_block_list.text:
Uh, y-you know... K-ki...
That thing I taught you last!
text_block_list.orig_text:
何をって、
ほら、
あの……
キッ、
キ……
救急処置の、
アレだよ！

text_block_list.name: Makoto
text_block_list.text:
Hey... What's with that wry smile?!
Gimme a straight answer!
text_block_list.orig_text:
何がって……
なんでおまえ笑ってやがんだ！？
ちゃんと答えろよ！

text_block_list.name: Makoto
text_block_list.text: Come on, don't mess me around here!
text_block_list.orig_text:
おい、
どっちなんだよ！？

text_block_list.name: Makoto
text_block_list.text: Huh? You think there's someone in need over there?
text_block_list.orig_text:
え？
　あっちで困ってる人の気配がする！？

text_block_list.name: Makoto
text_block_list.text: Don't you dare run!
text_block_list.orig_text: 待てこら逃げんな！

text_block_list.name: Makoto
text_block_list.text: Get back here!
text_block_list.orig_text: おーいっ！？

text_block_list.name: Makoto
text_block_list.text: Tell me if you did it or not!
text_block_list.orig_text: どっちなんだよーーーーーー！？

text_block_list.name: Narration
text_block_list.text:
Makoto couldn't help but blush every time
she touched her lips for a while after that.
text_block_list.orig_text:
それからしばらくの間、
マコトは唇に触れるたび赤面することになるのであった。
